head_commit.message:
feat(core): add Azure DefaultAzureCredential support

Add support for Azure's DefaultAzureCredential chain to authenticate
with Azure OpenAI endpoints, as an alternative to API keys.

- Add `azure_core` and `azure_identity` as optional workspace deps
- Add `azure-identity` feature flag to `codex-core` and `codex-cli`
- Add `AzureAuthMode` enum and `azure_auth` config field to `ModelProviderInfo`
- Create `azure_auth.rs` module with `AzureCredentialProvider` wrapper
- Add `AzureAuth` error variant for authentication failures
- Integrate token refresh into API request flow

Usage:
```toml
[model_providers.azure]
name = "Azure OpenAI"
base_url = "https://my-resource.openai.azure.com/openai/v1"
wire_api = "responses"
azure_auth = "default_credential"
query_params = { api-version = "2025-04-01-preview" }
```

Build with: `cargo build -p codex-cli --features azure-identity`

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

workflow_runs.display_title: core: preconnect Responses websocket for first turn

head_commit.message:
core: preconnect Responses websocket for first turn

Warm a session-level Responses websocket during session startup so the
first user turn can reuse the connection and avoid handshake latency.

Only reuse a preconnected socket when connection-scoped headers match
(web search eligibility and turn metadata). On mismatch, drop the
preconnected socket and open a fresh websocket.

Do not send response.create during preconnect; the first prompt is sent
only when submit_turn starts.

Also add websocket tests for startup preconnect reuse and mismatch
behavior, and adjust fallback tests for the extra preconnect attempt.

feat(core): add configurable log_dir (#10678)

Adds a top-level `log_dir` config key (defaults to `$CODEX_HOME/log`) so
one-off runs can redirect `codex-tui.log` via `-c`, e.g.:

  codex -c log_dir=./.codex-log

Also resolves relative paths in CLI `-c/--config` overrides for
`AbsolutePathBuf` values against the effective cwd (when available).

Tests:
- cargo test -p codex-core

one-off runs can redirect `codex-tui.log` via `-c`, e.g.:

`AbsolutePathBuf` values against the effective cwd (when available).

- cargo test -p codex-core
